verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a built-in AI assistant inside GrowthBook that users can hand tasks to. The official MCP server only lets external AI tools (Cursor, VS Code, Claude) call the REST API, which is an integration, not an in-product assistant. The "AI Visual Editor" is named but never described as accepting delegated tasks, so it counts only as an adjacent feature, and the Cmd+K command palette is navigation, not AI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
